_note: Static wiki reference data: milestone rewards for cumulative offerings given to the Harvest Goddess (see data/pointer_map.md's 'Harvest Goddess Total/Consecutive Liked/Loved Gifts' pointers for the live memory value this maps against). Unlike the Heart Level/Friendship/Affection tables, these are discrete one-time milestones rather than continuous tiers, so rows are stored as literal (offerings_given, reward_received) pairs -- no min/max banding needed. A live lookup can find the next unclaimed threshold (smallest offerings_given > current count) or the most recently crossed one (largest offerings_given <= current count), whichever the Reminders feature wants to surface.
